items.title: Israeli strike kills three Palestinians in Jenin
items.description: An Israeli drone strike killed three Palestinians in Jenin, the first such attack in the West Bank since February 2025.

items.title: After 6 months of war, Iran's battered regime remains entrenched
items.description: Instead of collapsing, the Iranian regime has dug in its heels and taken an even harder line.

items.description: The court in The Hague convicted the 66-year-old of war crimes and the crime of genocide.

items.description: Convicted genocidaire Ratko Mladić has died at the age of 84 in a UN prison in The Hague, where he was serving a life sentence. items.title: Kremlin Says Ukraine Peace Talks on ‘Deep Pause’
items.description: The New York Times reported that CIA Director John Ratcliffe visited Moscow this week to push the Kremlin towards a peace deal.

items.title: Former war commander Ratko Mladic to receive full state honors in Serbia
items.description: The former military leader, colloquially known as the 'Butcher of Bosnia', died Thursday in The Hague, where he was serving a life sentence for genocide, war crimes and crimes against humanity.

items.title: The man behind Srebrenica: Ratko Mladic dies at 84
items.description: For many, Ratko Mladic represented the horrors of the Bosnian War. He was convicted of genocide for the Srebrenica massacre and of other war crimes. Now he has died in detention at The Hague.

items.title: In Sudan’s civil war, both sides target journalists
items.description: Local journalists reporting on Sudan’s civil war and humanitarian crisis there are facing a campaign of intimidation by rival military forces.

items.title: Russia Preparing New Mobilization Wave of 600,000, Ukrainian Intelligence Says
items.description: Ukraine’s intelligence agencies say Russia is preparing a new mobilization wave that could bring 600,000 additional troops into the war effort across 2026–2027. Kyiv says Moscow is tightening recruitment and coercive measures as battlefield losses rise and contract recruitment slows.
